summary: List scheduled jobs with optional state and schedule-type filters.

state.description: Optional lifecycle-state filter such as active, paused, canceled, completed, or draft.

schedule_type.description: Optional schedule-type filter such as one_time, interval, calendar_rule, or conditional.

limit.description: Maximum number of jobs to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned by a previous list call.

output_schema.description: Job list result containing matching job records and the next cursor.
